deposits_utr_uq.name: deposits_utr_uq
deposits_utr_uq.where: utr IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'rejected'

pkg_buy_time_fmt.name: pkg_buy_time_fmt
pkg_buy_time_fmt.value: ("packages"."buy_start_time" IS NULL OR "packages"."buy_start_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$') AND ("packages"."buy_end_time" IS NULL OR "packages"."buy_end_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

pkg_buy_time_pair.name: pkg_buy_time_pair
pkg_buy_time_pair.value: ("packages"."buy_start_time" IS NULL) = ("packages"."buy_end_time" IS NULL) AND ("packages"."buy_start_time" IS NULL OR "packages"."buy_start_time" <> "packages"."buy_end_time")
